payload.summary: Twenty-two Dependabot vulnerabilities on main (2 critical, 11 high) have never been assessed for real exposure
payload.detail: Triage the Dependabot list and record, per advisory, whether it is reachable from the live site or confined to build/dev tooling. Why: 2 critical and 11 high are reported on the default branch and nobody has looked; npm audit alone does NOT see them — it found only one dev-only js-yaml advisory, so the earlier 'one low-priority issue' read was wrong. Dependabot also covers the Python worker, container images and Actions. Context: reported on every git push during the 2026-09-19 review. Owner: assistant to triage, user to approve any bump. Confidence: high — the counts come from GitHub's own push message. Depends on: nothing.
payload.source: session 2026-09-20 /ledger sweep — nine-agent repo maturity review
